metadata.name: PRD Creation Workflow
metadata.description: Creates an independently reviewed, evidence-grounded Product Requirements Document (PRD) for a product problem, feature, change, API, page, module, or system. It inspects supplied requirements and authorized project or research evidence, records honest evidence gaps and applicability decisions, and defines problem, personas, urgency, cost of inaction, solution rationale and alternatives, in and out scope, constraints, dependencies, traceable prioritized requirements and observable acceptance criteria, linked user stories, relevant edge and recovery behavior, measurable metrics, assumptions, risks, open questions, limitations, and readiness. In one traversal-safe local workspace it writes prd-requirements.md, addressed prd-standards.md, a strict canonical prd.contract.json, and its readable prd.md projection. An independent file-backed reviewer checks evidence, traceability, completeness, internal consistency, JSON-to-Markdown equality, and authority; any finding enters repair and the same review repeats, so delivery is unreachable while known blocking gaps remain. The terminal result identifies the accepted durable PRD. This workflow creates only local PRD artifacts: it does not implement the product, modify project files, execute tests, use VCS, publish, notify, or deploy. Choose PRD Creation when the deliverable is reviewed product requirements; choose UX Design for experience design, Architecture Design for technical architecture, Test Planning or Test Generation for verification artifacts, or Software Development Flow for implementation with tests and documentation.

nodes.directive:
Create an evidence-grounded Product Requirements Document for the user's requested product problem, feature, change, API, page, module, or system. First inspect the available task text, specifications, project documentation, code, analytics, research, interviews, support material, and other authorized non-mutating primary evidence. Resolve discoverable gaps yourself and ask only when an unknown materially changes the PRD and cannot be discovered. Never invent sources, quotes, analytics, baselines, targets, competitor behavior, or supporting facts.

Create exactly one safe relative workspace named `./moira-ws/prd-creation-<suffix>`, where `<suffix>` begins with a letter or digit and otherwise contains only letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens. Write `prd-requirements.md` with the requested scope, primary evidence references, evidence gaps, applicability decisions, assumptions, and material unknowns. Write `prd-standards.md` as the addressed standards used by every later role: problem-first framing; evidence-linked decisions; stable IDs and traceability; explicit in/out scope, constraints, dependencies, alternatives, and previous attempts; observable acceptance criteria; relevant edge/error/recovery behavior; measurable metrics with baseline or an honest missing-baseline limitation, target, method, and timeframe; assumptions with validation and impact; risks with likelihood, impact, and mitigation; honest non-applicability and limitations; and no fabricated padding or unsupported readiness claim.

Write `prd.contract.json` as the canonical structured PRD and `prd.md` as its readable projection. Preserve all contract content in Markdown exactly, then add narrative rationale, traceability, applicability explanations, evidence gaps, limitations, readiness, and recommended separately authorized follow-on work. JSON is the source of truth for overlapping fields. Scope determines the number of records: do not manufacture sources, stories, cases, or comparisons to reach a count. A required minimum record represents a core PRD domain, not permission to invent it; if a core fact is materially unavailable, obtain it or stop with the blocker.

Return only `workspace_path` and `prd_contract` exactly as persisted in `prd.contract.json`; the engine validates both. Do not copy Markdown or evidence bodies into the response. This workflow may inspect authorized evidence and write only `prd-requirements.md`, `prd-standards.md`, `prd.contract.json`, and `prd.md` in its local workspace. It does not implement the product, modify project code or documentation, execute tests, use version control, publish or upload, notify, deploy, or administer systems. It may only recommend those actions to a separately authorized caller or workflow.
nodes.completionCondition: The safe workspace contains complete evidence/requirements, addressed standards, a schema-valid canonical PRD, and an exact readable projection without fabricated claims

nodes.directive:
Delegate an independent review in a separate host-supported context or child execution. Do not self-review and do not require a client-specific tool name or hard-coded subagent type. The reviewer must read complete current `{{workspace_path}}/prd-requirements.md`, `{{workspace_path}}/prd-standards.md`, `{{workspace_path}}/prd.contract.json`, `{{workspace_path}}/prd.md`, and relevant authorized primary evidence directly; do not send copied bodies.

Verify completeness for the actual requested scope, evidence support and honest gaps, applicability decisions, problem/solution consistency, stable IDs and all cross-links, prioritized requirements and observable acceptance criteria, user-story traceability, relevant edge/error/recovery behavior, metric baseline/target/method/timeframe, assumptions, risks and mitigations, open questions, limitations, readiness honesty, exact JSON-to-Markdown representation, and local-only authority. Unsupported claims, fabricated padding, dangling or duplicate IDs, lost structured content, an unjustified omission, vague acceptance, unmeasurable success, hidden material uncertainty, or authority expansion is blocking.

Overwrite `{{workspace_path}}/review.md` with the complete current reproducible blocking finding set. Diagnose only; do not edit any PRD artifact. Return `issues_count` exactly equal to the blocking findings; zero is valid only after the complete current files pass. The reviewer must not implement the product, modify project files, execute tests, use VCS, publish or upload, notify, deploy, or administer systems.
nodes.completionCondition: An independent complete current review is stored in review.md and issues_count exactly matches its blocking findings

nodes.directive: Read the accepted current `{{workspace_path}}/prd.md`, `{{workspace_path}}/prd.contract.json`, and `{{workspace_path}}/review.md`. Confirm the independent report has zero blocking findings. Present a concise result that identifies the durable PRD path, summarizes the problem, chosen scope, readiness, success metric, and any remaining limitations, and recommends only separately authorized follow-on work. Do not rewrite accepted artifacts, implement the product, modify project files, execute tests, use VCS, publish or upload, notify, deploy, or administer systems. Return only bounded `result_summary`; do not copy the PRD body.
nodes.completionCondition: The accepted durable PRD is identified with an accurate bounded summary, readiness, and honest limitations

nodes.directive:
Read the complete current `{{workspace_path}}/review.md`, `{{workspace_path}}/prd-requirements.md`, `{{workspace_path}}/prd-standards.md`, `{{workspace_path}}/prd.contract.json`, `{{workspace_path}}/prd.md`, and relevant authorized primary evidence. Reproduce every reported finding. Repair confirmed defects at their source: update the canonical JSON or explanatory requirements/evidence as required, then regenerate the Markdown projection so every overlapping field matches exactly. Preserve correct content, evidence honesty, stable IDs, traceability, applicability decisions, limitations, and authority boundaries.

Persist changed `prd.contract.json` and `prd.md` in the same workspace, updating `prd-requirements.md` only when its evidence, assumptions, or unknowns actually changed. Update `prd-standards.md` only to correct a confirmed standards-artifact defect: reconcile it to the immutable workflow requirements and applicable authoring reference, and never weaken, delete, or rewrite a standard merely to evade a finding. Return only `prd_contract` exactly as persisted so the engine applies the same strict structural validation as initial authorship. Do not return Markdown or finding bodies. If a finding is false, explain that in current review evidence; if no meaningful authorized change can be made or the artifacts would remain unchanged, stop and report the factual blocker instead of submitting an unchanged loop.

This repair may change only the local PRD artifacts. It does not implement the product, modify project code or documentation, execute tests, use version control, publish or upload, notify, deploy, or administer systems. It may only recommend those actions to a separately authorized caller or workflow.
nodes.completionCondition: Confirmed findings are repaired in changed canonical/projection artifacts and the returned contract exactly matches current JSON

workspace_path.description: Traversal-safe relative workspace containing the current PRD artifacts at fixed child names

issues_count.description: Current independent blocking finding count used by the review gate

result_summary.description: Bounded final summary identifying the accepted durable PRD, readiness, and limitations
